types.definition: Approved evidence sources report incompatible asset states for overlapping time.
Equipment identity and functional-location history cannot both be true for the same interval.
A telemetry channel association conflicts with time-valid equipment-installation evidence.
Records imply relationships or events outside compatible validity intervals.
Competing records claim the same identity or one record appears to represent multiple assets.
Technical documentation and recorded installed configuration disagree.
A maintenance or work-order reference points to an incompatible asset context.
A source remains unchanged beyond an approved freshness or change event and conflicts with newer evidence.

extension_rule: Operator-specific extensions must use a separately versioned namespace and must not be mixed into v0.1 benchmark denominators without disclosure.
